releases.name: Winlator Mali Bionic 1.2.1
releases.body:
# Winlator Mali Bionic 1.2.1

A fixes-and-polish update to 1.2.

## ⚠️ Reinstall Required!
Uninstall the old version and install 1.2.1 fresh. Back up your game saves first (Save Manager, or copy them out of your container). Containers made on 1.2 are not carried over.

## Fixes for 1.2 user reports
- Fixed a reboot on some MediaTek Mali phones (JM Mali).
- Fixed a crash when opening a shortcut.
- Fixed the controller binding editor.
- Fixed the stutter when holding D-pad right.
- Fixed File Manager not opening (it needed `libcdio.dll`), and File Manager hanging on x86_64 Wine (replaced with Bannerlator's newer `wfm.exe` / `winhandler.exe`).

## Graphics and performance
- **Fullscreen modes:** Fit, Stretch, Fill and Integer, plus screen alignment (Center, Top, Bottom half), set per container or per game and changeable live in Display & Session.
- **EGL stripes fixed:** CPU writes into the window buffer are flushed per X batch.
- **ZeroFG:** the default multiplier is capped at the display refresh rate (40 fps on a 60 Hz screen now gives 1.5x instead of 2x with dropped frames).
- **Gladio:** refuses OpenGL contexts above 3.3 again; libGL stripped of debug info (1.48 MB to 488 KB).
- *

releases.name: Winlator Mali Bionic 1.2
releases.body:
Winlator Mali Bionic v1.2 Winlator Mali Bionic v1.2 is a major architectural overhaul over v1.1, introducing a native EGL rendering engine, ZeroFG Vulkan compute frame interpolation, a redesigned UI with Madeira Liquid Glass touch controls, two selectable BCn layers, hardware performance tools, kernel-direct telemetry, and a cloud-powered community configuration ecosystem. ⚠️ Reinstall Required!
🖥️ Native EGL Rendering Engine & Gladio Integration
  • High-Performance Native EGL Architecture: Migrated from the legacy v1.1 rendering stack (GLRenderer, DisplayX, VirGL, blit_converter, and Java EffectComposer) to Pipetto-crypto's native C++ EGL renderer at app/src/main/cpp/winlator/renderer/egl.cpp.
  • Elimination of Legacy Overhead: Removed the legacy DisplayX layer (displayx.cpp, DisplayXView), VirGL (VirGLRendererComponent), and blit_converter.cpp, eliminating over 3,500 lines of redundant CPU blit and synchronization code.
  • Gladio Native OpenGL Engine: In

releases.name: Winlator Mali Bionic 1.1
releases.body:
Winlator Mali Bionic v1.1

🚀 New Features

- Added Fake HDR.
- Added a Universal FPS Limiter.
- Added a Sharpness option.
- Added GTA V Optimization toggle in Shortcut Settings.
- Added DXVK Config toggle with built-in pre-made configuration presets.
- Automatically generates a dxvk.conf file for each container based on the selected preset.
- Added new DXVK versions.
- Added the new GameNative Vulkan Wrapper.
- Added new Box64 and FEX presets.

---

🎮 Unreal Engine 3 Preset

- Added a dedicated Unreal Engine 3 preset.
- Tested with X-Men Origins: Wolverine for improved compatibility and performance.

---

⚙️ Hybrid x86 FEXCore

- Added a custom Hybrid x86 FEXCore.

What does it do?

- Improves compatibility while maintaining high performance.
- Fixes physics issues in supported games that normally require x86 Reduced Precision to be completely disabled.

Why is it better?

Normally, disabling x86 Reduced Precision forces software emulation for all x86 code, which can significantly reduce performance.

Hybrid x86 only uses software emulation where it is actually needed (such as physics calculations), while allowing the rest of the game to run natively for much better performance.

releases.name: Winlator Mali Bionic 1.0 ( Updated Again )
releases.body:
Winlator Mali Bionic v1.0

New Features

- Multiple Vulkan Wrapper Selection — Select between Wrapper, Wrapper-Leegao, and Wrapper V2 on a per-container basis.
- ASTC Transcoding — Native ASTC texture transcoding using a modified version of leegao's bcn_layer with improved performance, memory usage, and stability.
- ETC2 Transcoding — Native ETC2 texture transcoding using a modified version of leegao's bcn_layer with improved performance, memory usage, and stability.
- Apex Frame Generation — Based on Motion Compute Frame Interpolator (MCFI), with additional implementation and optimizations for improved performance, stability, and compatibility. Apex also utilizes GPU resources alongside the game and may impact performance depending on your device.
- Advanced HUD — Enhanced in-game overlay based on Winlator Ludashi's HUD with additional refinements.
- Unified Control System — XInput, DInput, and Exclusive input modes have been unified into a single control system.
- Graphics Driver Manager — Install and manage Vulkan Wrappers and bcn_layer directly from local storage. User-installed drivers automatically take priority over bundled versions.
- Gyro View — Control the in-game camera

# Added

releases.name: star 1.3 - UI redesigns, Vegas Engine built in, New FPS Counter, New in-game menu redesign
releases.body: **After a lot of previews, star 1.3 is here. We had some juicy changes made! But first of all, credits!** - @jacojayy: All of the changes, excluding the Vegas work. - @leegao: Helping in Vegas. It was a pleasure to work and chat with you, hope we will do it again in the future! - @isygold: Developing Vegas ### NOTE - The Vegas FrameGen still doesnt work. - When installing Proton / Wine versions, do not panic. It will install over time, just wait! ## Changelog - Redesigned the in-game ui: - The in-game ui menu now has a modern and sleek look, making the experience way more fresh and easier. - Redesigned FPS Counter - The FPS Counter is now horizontal by default and can be customized via the in game menu. - Integrated Vegas into star. - Removed contents tab: - Contents can now be installed directly in the container / shortcut settings. - Revamped shortcut tab - Made the shortcut image size 2:3 - Removed the appearance tab to make the experience less buggy - Defaulted the theme to AMOLED. - Added the OneUI / HyperOS fix to the Wrapper settings.

releases.body: **After a long wait, we finally converted the old Java XML UI to the new Jetpack Compose UI. We also implemented Timeline Semaphore patches to a specific Turnip to have no regressions on newer DXVKs. Not only that, but the stores integration has been improved.** # Changelog - Fully converted Java XML UI to Jetpack Compose, giving the most unique look ever. This is the only Winlator fork to have this, big jump! - Modified controller implementation to work with the Jetpack Compose UI. This was broken before. - Modified the default Turnip to one with Timeline Semaphore patches built in, deleting regressions with newer DXVKs. - Stores implementation has been improved. Steam isnt fully working, we would need to implement Pluvia or something else to manage all the Steam stuff like GameNative does. - Rewrote controller implementation to work with the Jetpack compose UI - Updated the first installing screen **NOTE:** Even tho the container menu shows box64 0.3.7, it uses the one you chose. Its just a visual bug. # DXVK 2.5+ fix - Utilize the DXVK below with the defau

releases.body: **After a long wait, the time is here. We have successfuly implemented the built-in game stores such as Epic Games, Steam, GOG, Amazon Games to maximize your experience.** # Changelog - Implemented built-in game stores such as Amazon Games, Steam, GOG and Epic Games to make the ultimate Winlator experience. releases.name: star Bionic V1.0 - Stable Release
releases.body: **After a long wait, the Bionic version of star is finally released. We have so many huge changes here in this version, we promise.** # Changelog - Implemented a new FPS Counter - You can now easily manager your FPS Counter in the container menu. You can adjust It however you like, adding CPU Temperaturs, GPU Load or just having a simple FPS Counter. - Graphics Engine implemented (thanks to @StevenMXZ) - You can now use a new Super Resolution setting, a DLS Color Boost setting and most importantly, the HDR, like the one used in GameHub directly in the container! - Reimplemented the Save Manager from winlator cmod @coffincolors - You can now easily manager your save datas without even entering the container, by simply going in the menu and going in the saves page. - Reimplemented the export and import container feature. - Self explainatory. - Revamped the layout of the shortcut menu, inspired from winlator bionic by @de0ver - With the addition of sort, switch-able layout into grid or list and ability to import shortcut from i

We will fix it soon.
